scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Pets went out the village~!!
Gosh... what can I do... ?
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
我的宠物跑到村子外面去了~！！
天哪...我该怎么办...？

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
The day is not finished yet.
You can only help once a day. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
今天还没结束呢。
每天只能帮忙一次哦。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
My pets are in the field outside of the village.
Why did they leave? Please find them.
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
我的宠物在村子外面的田野里。
它们为什么跑掉了呢？请帮我找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Oh, thank you. You found all of 3 puppies.
Thanks a lot.
I hope this is useful to you. hoho.
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
哦，谢谢你。你找到了全部3只小狗。
非常感谢。
希望这个对你有用。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
Are you an adventurer? You came here right on time.
Puppies have been disappearing.
And someone said that they saw them out on the field just outside the village....
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
你是冒险者吗？你来得正是时候。
小狗们一直失踪。
有人看到它们在村子外面的田野里...

scripts.text:
[Angelo]
It's pretty difficult and dangerous to find 'em.
You have to find ^0000FF3 puppies^000000.
scripts.translation:
[安杰洛]
找到它们相当困难且危险。
你必须找到^0000FF3只小狗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puppy]
bow! wow wow!
scripts.translation:
[小狗]
汪！汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good. I found all 3 puppies.
Now I need to go tell Angelo.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好。我找到了全部3只小狗。
现在我要去告诉安杰洛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... who's a good puppy?
Ok, where are the others?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...谁是好小狗？
好吧，其他的小狗在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello.
I'm worried about ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000's on
the south beach.
I hope some experienced adventurers
will come to help.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
你好。
我很担心^FF0000变异海葵^000000在南边海滩的情况。
希望有经验的冒险者能来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello.
Have you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
你好。
你是来打^FF0000变异海葵^000000的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: ^006400What is happening here?^000000

[Lucia]
Here, take this ^006400Hydra Ball^000000.
Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
拿着，这是^006400海葵球^000000。
用它来捕捉^FF0000变异海葵^8B4513。^000000
希望你能成功~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ah, I misunderstood.
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
啊，我误会了。
那再见了。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
One day ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s
came here and surrounded the town.
We're not sure what attracted them but some say that it's because of you adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
有一天^FF0000变异海葵^000000来到这里，包围了城镇。
我们不确定是什么吸引了它们，但有人说这是因为你们冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
In any case, to contain the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s,
you have to use this specially designed tool a.k.a. a ^8B4513Hydra Ball^000000
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
总之，为了控制^FF0000变异海葵^000000，
你必须使用这个专门设计的工具，也就是^8B4513海葵球^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
If you still have the ^006400Hydra Ball^000000,
please use it on the ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s that
you can find at the beach.
If you are lucky, the tool will work perfectly.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
如果你还有^006400海葵球^000000，
请用它对付你在海滩上能找到的^FF0000变异海葵^000000。
如果你运气好，这个工具会完美起效。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
I hope many adventurers
volunteer for this job.
 
I really hate Hydra!
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
我希望有很多冒险者
自愿承担这项工作。
 
我真的很讨厌海葵！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello, you really did it!
I hope you will come
again to help me.
Have a nice day~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
你好，你真的做到了！
希望你会再来帮我。
祝你有美好的一天~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Hello, you really did it!
 
I'd like to reward you,
however your bags are full.
Please make room and come back!
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
你好，你真的做到了！
 
我想奖励你，
但是你的背包满了。
请腾出空间再回来！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Did you need another ^006400Hydra Ball^000000?
I will give you one more.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
你还需要另一个^006400海葵球^000000吗？
我再给你一个。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Any problems?
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: ^006400Tell me again what happened^000000
scripts.translation: ^006400再告诉我一次发生了什么^000000

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ok, please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
好的，请帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 you're back.
I'm so grateful for your help.
Each ^006400Hydra Ball^000000 is provided ^006400every 24 hours^000000
Please come at the appropriate time.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，你回来了。
非常感谢你的帮助。
每^00640024小时^000000会提供一次^006400海葵球^000000。
请在合适的时间再来。

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 you're back.
Did you come here to hunt ^FF0000Strange Hydra^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，你回来了。
你是来这里打^FF0000变异海葵^000000的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: ^006400What is happening here?^000000

[Lucia]
Here, take this ^006400Hydra Ball^000000.
Use it to capture a ^FF0000Strange Hydra^8B4513.^000000
I hope you can do it~!
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
拿着，这是^006400海葵球^000000。
用它来捕捉^FF0000变异海葵^8B4513。^000000
希望你能成功~！

scripts.text:
[Lucia]
Ah, I misunderstood.
See you then.
scripts.translation:
[露西亚]
啊，我误会了。
那再见了。

scripts.text: - You can't start the quest. Please reduce the weight in your inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 无法开始任务。请减轻背包重量。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Yo, do you know a berry called ^FF0000Guarana^000000?
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
嘿，你知道一种叫^FF0000瓜拉那^000000的浆果吗？

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana is a really special berry raised in a specific area, it relieves physical fatigue, and gives power to the body. It even detoxes waste from the body.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
瓜拉那是一种在特定地区种植的特殊浆果，它能缓解身体疲劳，为身体提供能量，甚至能排出体内的毒素。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
I used to sell the candy made of it back in the day.
I got a prize sometimes every year in the <annual best product contest>. Those were the good 'ol days.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
我以前卖用这种浆果做的糖果。
我有时候每年都能在<年度最佳产品大赛>中获奖。那是多么美好的时光啊。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Since then, the output of that fruit has reduced and the price has gone up so now candy ingredients were changed to coconuts or other tropical fruits instead. I miss the guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
从那以后，这种水果的产量减少，价格也随之上涨，所以现在糖果的原料改用了椰子或其他热带水果。我很怀念瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text: How can I taste this guarana candy?
scripts.translation: 我怎么才能尝到这种瓜拉那糖？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Hmm? I already sold out of all my old supply.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
嗯？我以前的存货已经卖光了。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
But if you can find some guarana, I can make it for you.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
但如果你能找到一些瓜拉那，我可以为你制作。

scripts.text: How do I find guarana?
scripts.translation: 我怎么找到瓜拉那？

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Will you find the guarana?? Hoooooh~
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
你要去找瓜拉那吗？哇哦~

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Can you find it?
It's probably very expensive.
Trading isn't my thing. Let me think.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
你能找到吗？
那可能非常昂贵。
交易不是我的强项。让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Let me introduce you to someone with whom I used to do guarana business with.
He might still be dealing it.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
让我介绍你认识一个人，我以前和他做过瓜拉那的生意。
他可能还在做这门生意。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
His name is Cherto.
If you can't find him in the city, go to museum.
He's a vain person so he likes to act big.
He's probably wandering in the museum trying to show off to someone for sure.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
他叫切尔托。
如果你在城市里找不到他，就去博物馆。
他是个爱慕虚荣的人，喜欢摆架子。
他肯定正在博物馆里四处走动，向人炫耀。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Don't you want to try the guarana candy?
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
你不想尝尝瓜拉那糖吗？

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Those were the good 'ole days...
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
那是多么美好的时光啊...

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
If you want to get the guarana, find Cherto.
Maybe he will be in the museum.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
如果你想要瓜拉那，去找切尔托。
他可能在博物馆里。

scripts.text: - The guarana that I had has disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 我拥有的瓜拉那已经不见了。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Did you get the guarana?
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
你拿到瓜拉那了吗？

scripts.text: - You give the guarana to him. -
scripts.translation: - 你把瓜拉那交给了他。 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Wow! You have special talent.
It's the best thing I have ever seen so far. Cool~!
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
哇！你很有天赋。
这是我见过最棒的作品。太酷了~！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Good, let's make the candy~!
Long time no see my wonderful guarana candy...
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
很好，让我们来做糖果吧~！
好久没见到我美味的瓜拉那糖了...

scripts.text:
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
- hash hash hash hash hash hash -
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙沙沙沙沙沙沙 -
- 沙沙沙沙沙沙沙沙 -

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Look! It's the popular guarana candy.
Try to savor its amazing taste hey~ take it easy. hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
看！这就是受欢迎的瓜拉那糖。
试着品味一下它惊人的味道吧，嘿~ 放轻松。哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
瓜拉那糖。这绝对是我一生中独一无二的杰作！

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Since you helped me, guarana supply has been steadily rising.
So, naturally I'm back to making guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
多亏了你帮忙，瓜拉那的供应一直稳步增加。
所以，我自然而然地重新开始制作瓜拉那糖了。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
What about it? Wanna buy some?
It's 4000 zeny each.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
怎么样？想买一些吗？
每个4000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Buy a Guarana Candy.
scripts.translation: 购买瓜拉那糖

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Here is a delicious guarana candy.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
这是一块美味的瓜拉那糖。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
What? You should say before if you don't have money!
Even if you are poor, I can't give this away for free.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
什么？没钱你应该早点说啊！
就算你穷，我也不能免费送你。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Sometimes some people don't like it due to it's arousal effect.
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
有些人因为它的兴奋效果而不喜欢它。

scripts.text:
[Candy Maker]
Guarana candy. That was the most unique masterpiece in my life for sure!
scripts.translation:
[糖果师]
瓜拉那糖。这绝对是我一生中独一无二的杰作！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Hmm... hey man, you are from outside, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
嗯...嘿，伙计，你是外地人吧？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto can figure it out even if it's the first time. You can't trick Cherto.
Cherto has sharp eyes like an eagle! Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
切尔托就算第一次见也能看穿你。你骗不了切尔托。
切尔托的眼睛像老鹰一样锐利！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Ok, ok. Yes, yes. I see!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
好的，好的。是的，是的。我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Anyway, you arrived in Brasilis but don't know what to do?
Am I right?
You don't know how fortunate you are to have found a really proper helper as myself.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
总之，你来到了巴西，却不知道该怎么办？
我猜得没错吧？
你不知道自己有多幸运，能遇到像我这样得力的助手。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto takes it by your expression that you want to say, ''You are a master!'' Right?
Cherto, I can read and figure out all at once! That is written in your face!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
切尔托从你的表情看出，你想说“你是大师！”对吧？
切尔托一眼就能看穿一切！这都写在你的脸上了！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Cherto would love to stay here and explain everything to you but he is a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
切尔托本想留在这里给你解释一切，但我是个大忙人。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If you have a curious thing to ask to Cherto. Cherto will be kind enough to answer.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
如果你有什么好奇的问题想问切尔托，我会很乐意回答的。

scripts.text: Guarana?
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
What? Do you want to find a guarana?
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
什么？你想找瓜拉那？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Guarana is only raised in this area, it has a soft inside and is coverd with a light fur.
It seems a little bit weird but the flower is really big and smells beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
瓜拉那只生长在这个地区，内部柔软，表面覆盖着浅色的绒毛。
虽然看起来有点奇怪，但它的花非常大，而且香气扑鼻。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
A long time ago, guarana was used to relieve desease and thirst. But recently it's getting popular to revitalize body power and increase blood circulation.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
很久以前，瓜拉那被用来缓解疾病和口渴。但最近，它因能恢复体力和促进血液循环而变得很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Although it has such great effects, Cherto is sorry to inform you that we can't get it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
虽然它有这么好的功效，但很遗憾地通知你，我们现在已经买不到了。

scripts.text: Whaaaat??
scripts.translation: 什...什么？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
For a while now, guarana berries haven't been growing here.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
有一段时间，这里的瓜拉那果实没有生长。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Even if Cherto managed to find one, it will rot quickly.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
即使切尔托设法找到一个，它也会很快腐烂。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If only it didn't happen!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
要是没发生这种事就好了！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Quiet!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
This story has been forbidden! Someone might be listening to our conversation...
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
安静！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！
这个故事是被禁止的！可能有人在偷听我们的谈话...

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If Cherto tells you, you might get us into trouble. But you look like you really wanna know so let me give you a tip.
Come closer. Cherto will whisper so nobody can listen in.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
如果切尔托告诉你，可能会让我们惹上麻烦。但你看起来真的很想知道，所以我给你个提示。
靠近点。切尔托会小声说，这样没人能听到。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
A Guarana boy was born.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
一个瓜拉那男孩出生了。

scripts.text: Guarana kid?
scripts.translation: 瓜拉那小孩？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
There was woman who was an expert botanist.
The woman was really popular to all living creatures.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
有一位精通植物学的女子。
她在所有生物中都非常受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
At around the time her baby was born, she started a guarana farm. For some reason, her brothers were jealous so they destroyed the farm and disappeared.
That kind of story...
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
就在她生下宝宝前后，她开始种植瓜拉那。不知为何，她的兄弟们嫉妒她，于是毁掉了瓜拉那田并消失了。
就是那种故事...

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
We can't be sure that baby was born in the world but since that time, all guarana in Brasilis disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
我们无法确定那个宝宝是否真的降生到这个世界上，但从那时起，巴西所有的瓜拉那都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Who is the guarana kid?
Pedro who is famous as a greedy man?
Meto who can't endure about all the fruits?
Hovenue who is gloomy?
They might know~!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
谁是那个瓜拉那小孩？
是那个以贪婪闻名的佩德罗？
还是那个对水果无法忍受的梅托？
或者是那个阴郁的霍维纽？
他们可能知道~！

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
What about you?
Who is the guarana kid?
Will you figure out it? hohohhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
那你呢？
你知道谁是瓜拉那小孩吗？
你能找到他吗？hohohhhhh~

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Can you find the guarana kid?
Maybe yes? Maybe no?
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
你能找到瓜拉那小孩吗？
也许能？也许不能？

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Did you find guarana kid?
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
你找到瓜拉那小孩了吗？

scripts.text: - I tell Cherto about the kid making animal-like sounds. -
scripts.translation: - 告诉切尔托那个发出像动物叫声的小孩。 -

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
Hoooh. That's unbelievable.
That kid might be a guarana kid. Sure...
According to the story the kid can have conversations with animals.
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
哇哦。这太不可思议了。
那个小孩可能就是瓜拉那小孩。没错...
根据传说，那个小孩能与动物对话。

scripts.text:
[Cherto]
If he can make crying sounds of animals, they might be able to converse!
scripts.translation:
[切尔托]
如果他能发出动物哭泣的声音，他们也许就能交流！

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
Brasilis' climate is special.
This climate offers special cases in botany classes different from any other regions of the world.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
巴西的气候很特别。
这种气候造就了植物学上独特的案例，与世界上其他任何地区都不同。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
The plants here have robust frames and are clear and colorful.
Here the plants are really huge and we can feel their presence.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
这里的植物骨架粗壮，色彩清晰鲜艳。
这里的植物真的巨大，我们能感受到它们的存在。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
One of them, a Water Lily, is a really gorgeous and unique plant.
This flower is quite sensitive so it doesn't bloom everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
其中一种，莲花，是一种真正华丽而独特的植物。
这种花相当敏感，所以并不是到处都会开花。

scripts.text: Interesting.
scripts.translation: 很有趣。

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

I guess you aren't interested in botany.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
看来你对植物学不感兴趣呢。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
It doesn't appear easily and it is a mysterious flower even to the natives, so the Brasilis people believe that a person will get great luck if someone finds it.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
这种花很少见，连原住民都觉得它神秘，所以巴西人都相信，找到它的人会获得巨大的好运。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]

scripts.translation:

作为一名植物学家，我一直在这里徘徊，希望能找到这朵幸运之花，但不出所料，它还没有现身。

scripts.text:
[Karmen]
I believe that with enough perseverence, this flower will show me it's beautiful brilliance.
scripts.translation:
[卡门]
我相信只要坚持不懈，这朵花终会向我展示它美丽的光辉。

scripts.text:

呵呵...
那么，陌生人，你为什么来这里呢~？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard you knows lots of stories, is that true?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说你知道很多故事，是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Wooo! how you know my grandma knows lots of stories, amazing~?
Grandma is really wise and kind so, I heard lotsa things.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
哇哦！你怎么知道我奶奶知道很多故事，太厉害了~？
奶奶既聪明又善良，所以我听了很多故事。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Hehe. Kaka always listens to many stories every night, he really likes my stories.
Kaka always makes me happy because he asks so many curious things. That is pure happiness.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
呵呵。卡卡每晚都会听很多故事，他真的很喜欢我讲的故事。
卡卡总是问我很多好奇的问题，这让我很开心。那是纯粹的幸福。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Ok, Kaka why don't you invite our guest today to our small meeting?
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
好吧，卡卡，为什么不邀请今天的客人参加我们的小聚会呢？

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Ok grandma~!!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
好的奶奶~！！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Hey~ do you have special story that you want to listen to?
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
嘿~ 你想听什么特别的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
About the mysterious water lily?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
关于神秘莲花的故事？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Water lily....
It's from a long long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
莲花...
那是很久很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Before Brasilis was established.
A tribe that lived with the giant waterfall and jungle as friends spent their whole time with nature.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
在巴西建立之前，
有一个部落与巨大的瀑布和丛林为友，他们与自然和谐共处。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
One of tribe chiefs had a pretty daughter called 'Naia'.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
部落首领有一个美丽的女儿，名叫“奈亚”。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Naia liked listening to stories like Kaka so, her mom told her stories every night about nature and gods.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
奈亚像卡卡一样喜欢听故事，所以她的妈妈每晚都会给她讲关于自然和神灵的故事。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Woooa, she's just like me!
Maybe she would be pretty... hehe.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
哇哦，她跟我一样！
也许她也很漂亮...嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
According to her mother...
If the moon in the sky loves some woman in the earth, he turns her into a star so that they can stay together forever.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
据她母亲说...
如果天上的月亮爱上了地上的女子，他就会将她变成星星，这样他们就能永远在一起。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
After Naia heard this story, she went to her dad to ask if it was true or not.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
奈亚听完这个故事后，去找爸爸问这是不是真的。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
So, what did he say?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
那他怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
^3131FF'My dear, Naia the moon is one of the bravest men. But he can no longer have a bride. So you can't become a star... Sorry~.^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
^3131FF“亲爱的奈亚，月亮是最勇敢的男人之一。但他不能再娶新娘了。所以你不能变成星星...抱歉~。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Did Naia wants to be the bride of the man?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
奈亚想成为那个男人的新娘吗？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Yes Kaka, imagine the moon how beautiful and mysterious, that's just ideal for girls.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
是的，卡卡。想象一下月亮是多么美丽和神秘，这对女孩来说简直是完美的理想。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
But the moon doesn't meet a human as his wife anymore? What was going on with Naia?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
但月亮不再娶人类做妻子了？奈亚后来怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Naia was really a nice girl.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
奈亚真的是个很好的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Although her parents tried to prevent her, she still went to the forest to meet the moon every night.
Sadly, even with all of her effort, the moon didn't show any reaction to her.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
尽管父母试图阻止她，她仍然每晚去森林见月亮。
可惜，无论她多么努力，月亮都没有对她做出任何反应。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
One day she also went to the top of the mountain to be closer to him. She decided to take a rest for a while around the lake.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
有一天，她也爬到了山顶，为了离他更近一些。她决定在湖边休息一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
That's when.. Naia saw it.
It was the moon he was shining beautifully over the waving lake lightly.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
就在这时...奈亚看到了它。
那是月亮，它正美丽地照耀着轻轻荡漾的湖面。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
I know, it's just the moon reflecting on the water. Right?!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
我知道，那只是月亮在水中的倒影。对吧？！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
Yes, but to her, the image made her fall into the lake without hesitating and drowned.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
是的，但对她来说，那个景象让她毫不犹豫地跳入湖中，淹死了。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
Oh no.
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
The moon was also watching her from the sky.
He felt sad and pitied her. So he decided to turn her into a beautiful flower to thank her for her love.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
月亮也在天空中注视着她。
他感到悲伤，怜悯她。于是，为了感谢她的爱，他决定将她变成一朵漂亮的花。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
That is the story of the mysterious flower people called the Brasilis Water Flower.
This Naia flower appears as light white during daytime but in the night turns into red due to it's love connection to the moon.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
这就是人们所说的巴西水花的神奇的故事。
这种奈亚花在白天呈现出淡淡的白色，但在夜晚，由于它与月亮的爱之羁绊，会变成红色。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
How sad but beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
真悲伤，但也很美！

scripts.text:
[Marta]
How about you stranger?
Did you enjoy this story?
If you want to listen to another story, just come to me.
If you don't mind playing with my grandson a ~ little. hoohoo.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
那么，陌生人，你觉得怎么样？
你喜欢这个故事吗？
如果你想听另一个故事，随时来找我。
如果你不介意和我的孙子玩一会儿的话。呼呼。

scripts.text:
[Kaka]
My grandma is really a bit tired doing some tribe stuff!
Could you come another day?
scripts.translation:
[卡卡]
我奶奶做部落的事情真的很累！
你能改天再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Marta]
You are not from around here.
I can sense a strange earth smell.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
你不是这里的人。
我能感觉到你身上有一股陌生的泥土气息。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
But your eyes shine with strength.
Indeed you are spreading out spirit and will from your whole body.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
但你的眼睛闪烁着力量。
你确实在全身散发着精神和意志。

scripts.text:
[Marta]
If you work at it you will be a great person someday.
scripts.translation:
[玛尔塔]
如果你努力的话，总有一天你会成为一个伟大的人。

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
Jasira!!!
Where are you going again?!!
come back~, please!!
scripts.translation:
[远处的声音]
雅西拉！！！
你又要去哪里？！！
回来吧~，求你了！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Mom, I have to go out!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
妈妈，我必须出去！！

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
No way~!! You shouldn't!!
scripts.translation:
[远处的声音]
不行~！！你不应该去！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Gosh.. today also failed.
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
天哪...今天又失败了。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
......
What's up? Why are you looking at me?
I don't want to be a showgirl!! Get out!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
......
怎么了？你为什么盯着我看？
我不想当什么展示品！！快走开！！

scripts.text: Nothing, sorry.
scripts.translation: 没什么，抱歉。

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
I am so sad!!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
我好难过！！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
It's not your business.
You are just an outsider!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
这不关你的事。
你只是个外人！

scripts.text: How rude!
scripts.translation: 真没礼貌！

scripts.text: Just trying to help.
scripts.translation: 只是想帮帮你。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
What's it matter to you that I'm rude??!!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
我粗鲁又怎样？！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know that I'm just passing by but I might be able to help you. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道我只是路过，但我也许能帮到你。你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This kind of meeting could be more than just a coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这次相遇可能不仅仅是巧合。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm can you tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
ja...
Jasira.
My name is Jasira.
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
雅...
雅西拉。
我叫雅西拉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nice name~.
Jasira what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好名字~。
雅西拉，发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I have to meet 'Jasi' but I can't go out....
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我要去见“雅西”，但我不能出门....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
who is Jasi?
Your.... lover?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西是谁？
你的....恋人？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
l...o...v...e...lover??!!
No way~
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
恋...人...？！！
才不是呢~

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If he is my lover, it would be great... but...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
如果他是我的恋人就好了...但是...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Jasi is......
the great moon.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
雅西是......
伟大的月亮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The moon?
Maybe... are you talking about the moon from the story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
月亮？
难道...你说的是故事里的月亮？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Yeah!
Dear Jasi is from the moon from the sky!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
是的！
亲爱的雅西来自天空中的月亮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you thinking like that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你为什么这么想？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Cuz' Jasi is really gorgeous and the most important thing is he is taking care of the water lily in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
因为雅西真的很英俊，而且最重要的是他在照顾巴西的莲花。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Brasilis water lily??!!
Isn't it the uniqe flower?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
巴西的莲花？！！
难道就是那种独特的花？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Right. It's a really mysterious flower and difficult to find.
But around Jasi there are lots of water lilies.
That's why I believe Jasi is the moon.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
没错。那是一种很神奇的花，很难找到。
但在雅西身边有很多莲花。
所以我相信雅西就是月亮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is Jasi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
He is deep inside the Jungle.
As you can see I am so weak so, I've been staying home. But once, I was strong enough to leave this village.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
他在丛林深处。
你看，我现在这么虚弱，只能一直待在家里。但有一次，我身体好到可以走出这个村庄。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I just wandered the jungle and fell down somewhere and that's where I saw him.
He was so nice. He helped heal me and guided me back home.
That was really really great time.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我只是在丛林里闲逛，然后摔倒了，就在那里遇见了他。
他真好。他帮我治疗了伤口，还带我回了家。
那真是非常非常美好的时光。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Since I came back home, my parents punished me.
I can understand why they are worrying but i missed Jasi a lot!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
回到家后，父母惩罚了我。
我理解他们为什么担心，但我真的很想念雅西！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you meet him after recovering your strength?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等你恢复体力后，再去见他怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
.................
I wanna see him right now...
Help Jasira.
scripts.translation: 帮助雅西拉

scripts.text: Ignore her.
scripts.translation: 无视她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry I can't help you. Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我帮不了你。振作点！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Crying........

[{0}]
Jasira I came here to find the Brasilis water lily.
Don't you think fate has brought us together?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雅西拉，我来这里是为了寻找巴西的莲花。
难道不是命运让我们相遇的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you tell me how to find Jasi, I can help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你告诉我怎么找到雅西，我就可以帮你。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Really? But I don't know exactly how to get there. I was just wandering around when I met him.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
真的吗？但我不知道确切的路怎么走。我只是在闲逛时遇见他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can't you remember anything?
If you know something you've gotta tell me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你一点印象都没有吗？
如果你知道什么，一定要告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
让我想想... 我当时在一个瀑布附近闲逛，然后掉进了水里，接着就被吸到了某个地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good, that's better than nothing! I will look for a similar place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好，总比没有线索强！我会去找找看有没有类似的地方。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I gave you your information, so can you do me a favor?
It's really simple...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我把情报都告诉你了，你能帮我个忙吗？
其实很简单...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I'd like to give a delicious fruit.
The place where Jas seemed cozy but I didn't see any food around... So if he sees a yummy fruit he will be happy!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我想送他一些美味的水果。
雅西住的地方看起来很舒适，但我没看到周围有食物... 所以如果他看到好吃的水果，一定会很高兴！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Give him 10 Banana and tell him that I really miss him.
Sorry for ignoring you before. Please, only you can help me!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
给他10个香蕉，并告诉他我很想念他。
抱歉之前忽略了你。拜托了，只有你能帮到我！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If you meet Jasi, give him 10 Bananas.
Let's see... I was wandering around a waterfall then fell down into the water then I was sucked into somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
如果你见到雅西，请给他10个香蕉。
让我想想... 我当时在一个瀑布附近闲逛，然后掉进了水里，接着就被吸到了某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
If you can't find the way, go up to the waterfall and ask the kids in Brasilis village.
I heard one of the children went to a strange place before. He might've gone to the same place as me!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
如果你找不到路，就去瀑布那里问问巴西村庄的小孩。
我听说有个孩子之前去过一个奇怪的地方。他可能和我去了同一个地方！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Did you meet Jasi?
Did you talk about me?
You didn't? Uh? Stupid! Gosh~!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
你见到雅西了吗？
有跟我提起我吗？
没有吗？啊？笨蛋！真是的~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey girl~ you've got a short temper.
I did see him and I talked about you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，女孩~ 你的脾气真急。
我见到他了，也跟你提过你！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Did you?
What did he say?
Does he remember me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
真的吗？
他说了什么？
他记得我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That you have a really good heart~
I told him that you will try to meet him when your condition gets better.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
说你心地很好~
我告诉他，等你身体好起来，就会去见他。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Yeahhhhh!!
Thank you! You are more reliable than I thought you would be.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
耶~~~~！！
谢谢你！你比我想象的更可靠呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, I'm looking for a fruit that's brown and has a hard shell.
It has juice inside and can be used as a cup to drink out of.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，我在找一种棕色、外壳很硬的水果。
里面有很多汁水，可以当杯子用来喝水。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Duh! You mean a coconut right?!
They're everywhere here in Brasilis.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哈！你是说椰子吧？！
在巴西这里到处都是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks Jasira!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢雅西拉！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I should take care of my strength by myself!
I can't just lie in my bed forever. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我应该自己努力恢复体力！
不能一直躺在床上。你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Uh? Why have you come back?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
啊？你怎么又回来了？

scripts.text: - You tell her what Jasi told you to tell her -
scripts.translation: - 告诉她雅西让你转达的话 -

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Oh... really?
Did he say that?
Gosh! Gosh!!!
Kkkkkaaaaa - !!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哦...真的吗？
他这么说的吗？
天哪！天哪！！！
卡...卡...卡...！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks to you, I was able to get a flower.
Thanks a lot!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
多亏了你，我拿到了一朵花。
非常感谢！！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Wooow. It's so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
哇哦。真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Ah... can I see it for a second?
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
啊...能让我看一眼吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
Surprise~!!
I've been working on this hat while you were gone and now it's complete with the water lily flower!
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
惊喜~！！
趁你不在的时候，我一直在做这顶帽子，现在配上莲花就完工了！

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I know, I know! I'm the best...
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我知道，我知道！我是最棒的...

scripts.text:
[Jasira]
I just need to get a little bit stronger!
I can't just lie in bed forever. My Jasi is waiting for me~
scripts.translation:
[雅西拉]
我只需要再强壮一点！
不能一直躺在床上。我的雅西在等着我呢~

scripts.text:
[Distant Sound]
Jasira!!!
Where are you going again?!!
Come back~, please!!
scripts.translation:
[远处的声音]
雅西拉！！！
你又要去哪里？！！
回来吧~，求你了！！

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Girl]
Please mom~!
Please let me go!
scripts.translation:
[巴西女孩]
拜托了，妈妈~！
请让我去吧！

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
Oh, I haven't seen another person in such a long time.
scripts.translation:
[隐居者]
好久没有见到其他人了。

scripts.text: Keep going.
scripts.translation: 继续前进

scripts.text: Are you the moon?
scripts.translation: 你是月亮吗？

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
You don't have specific business with me.
scripts.translation:
[隐居者]
你并没有特别的事情要找我。

scripts.text:
[Recluse]
Moon?
My name is Jasi.
My family has worked to take care of the water lily from generation to generation.
scripts.translation:
[隐居者]
月亮？
我叫雅西。
我家世世代代都在照料莲花。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Basically the Brasilis water lily is too shy to appear in front of people so, they only bloom in rare places. I guess they like it here, though, that's why I've been staying here for such a long time.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
巴西的莲花非常害羞，很少在人前出现，只在稀少的地方绽放。我想它们很喜欢这里，所以我在这里待了这么久。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
My family has taken care of the water lily calmly to prevent harm from people's hand or monsters.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我家一直平静地照料着莲花，防止它们受到人类或魔物的伤害。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you remember a girl named Jasi.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还记得一个叫雅西的女孩吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Ja...si..........
Ah!! a hurry scurry girl. 
Gosh.. I was in trouble due to that girl.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
雅...西..........
啊！！那个急躁的女孩。
天哪...因为那个女孩，我差点陷入麻烦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Trouble?

[Jasi]
One day a young lady appeared with lots of scars so I helped her. Then suddenly she tried to pick up the water lily and asked me to accept her as my wife or make her into a water lily what a nutcase!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
有一天，一位满身伤痕的年轻女士出现了，我帮助了她。然后她突然想摘走莲花，并要求我娶她为妻，或者把她变成一朵莲花，真是个疯子！

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I was barely able to calm down and send her to the village.
My life is that water lily so I didn't want anything embarrassing to happen.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我好不容易才让她冷静下来，把她送回了村庄。
我的生命就是这朵莲花，我不想发生任何尴尬的事情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a gift from Jasira to say sorry for that time.
She is really sad that can't come here by herself due to private difficulties.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是雅西拉寄来的礼物，为了那件事道歉。
她因为私事无法亲自前来，感到非常难过。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
What are you saying?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你在说什么？

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦对了，我忘了带10根香蕉 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Ah! Bananas! Wow it's been a long time. She's pretty considerate isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
啊！香蕉！哇，已经很久没吃了。她真贴心，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Anyway is that all the business you have with me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
总之，这就是你要找我的所有事情吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm honestly I was wondering to find water lily and met you by coincidence. Jasira told me her sad story so that's what led me here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，说实话，我是想寻找莲花，偶然遇到了你。雅西拉告诉了我她的悲伤故事，所以我才来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I got it.
As you can see, there are lots of Brasilis water lily around here.
If you make sure that you won't destroy them you can appreciate them as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我明白了。
如你所见，这里有很多巴西的莲花。
只要你保证不会破坏它们，你可以尽情欣赏。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Did you enjoy the water lily?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你欣赏莲花尽兴了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我忘了那种水果叫什么名字了...

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I forgot what the name of that fruit was...
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我忘了那种水果叫什么名字了...

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Did you find the fruit?
Oh right this is....?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你找到那种水果了吗？
对了，这个叫...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's called a 'coconut'.

[Jasi]
Ahah! COCONUT!!
Now I remember thank you very much. I can't remember the last time I had this fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
啊哈！椰子！！
我想起来了，非常感谢。我已经很久没吃过这种水果了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I guess I should keep my promise.
You can take one Water lily.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我想我应该信守承诺。
你可以摘一朵莲花。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I hope the Brasilis water lily will understand me.
You better grab the flower while you have a chance~
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
希望巴西的莲花能理解我的心意。
趁现在还有机会，赶紧把花摘走吧~

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Oh, can you tell that girl Jasira something for me?
Tell her that I am not the moon from the story, but I want to become the moon to shine only for her.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
哦，你能帮我告诉那个女孩雅西拉几句话吗？
告诉她，我不是故事里的月亮，但我想成为月亮，只为她一人闪耀。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
The flowers blooming from the Water lily today is wonderful.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
今天从莲花上绽放的花朵真美。

scripts.text: An unusual Water lily is blooming here. You can't stop staring at it, knowing that few people have seen this flower bloom.
scripts.translation: 这里有一株罕见的莲花正在绽放。你知道很少有人见过它开花，所以忍不住一直盯着看。

scripts.text: Pick up the flower.
scripts.translation: 摘取花朵

scripts.text: Keep gazing.
scripts.translation: 继续凝视

scripts.text: - You can't avoid staring at it's beauty. -
scripts.translation: - 你无法移开视线，被它的美丽深深吸引。 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Uh! What are you doing??!!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
喂！你在干什么？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a person who really needs this flower, can I just take one of 'em?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有个人非常需要这朵花，我可以摘一朵吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
As I said earlier, I am the guardian of this water lily.
I can't just stand by here and watch you pluck even a single flower from it.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
正如我之前所说，我是这株莲花的守护者。
我不能站在这里看着你从上面摘哪怕一朵花。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey man~ I brought these delicious fruits for you... try it! They are really well matured and fresh bananas.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，伙计~ 我给你带了这些美味的水果...尝尝看！它们非常成熟，是新鲜的香蕉。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
What are you saying?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你在说什么？

scripts.text: - Oh yeah, I forgot to bring 10 Bananas -
scripts.translation: - 哦对了，我忘了带10根香蕉 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Hmm... It's been so long since I've had this fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
嗯...我已经很久没吃过这种水果了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
I will just try one. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
我就尝一个。仅此而已。

scripts.text:
- munch -
- mumble mumble mumble -
scripts.translation:
- 咀嚼声 -
- 含糊不清的声音 -

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Uh, this taste... is!
I remember my mom baking these into a tasty bread!
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
嗯，这个味道...是！
我想起来了，妈妈曾把这些烤成美味的面包！

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It makes me miss my childhood.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
这让我想起了我的童年。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Hoho!!!!
I've been here for as long as I can remember...
I don't have enough time to even do simple things like eat delicious fruit.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
呵呵！！
从我记事起我就在这里了...
我连吃顿像样的水果的时间都没有。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It was a really delicious banana.
But rules are rules!
I must do my duty.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
那根香蕉真的很美味。
但规矩就是规矩！
我必须履行我的职责。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please! I just need one flower~ What can I do to convince you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
拜托了！我只想要一朵花~ 我该怎么做才能说服你呢？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Rules are rules, what do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
规矩就是规矩，你还想让我怎样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Didn't that banana remind you of your childhood? What can I get for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
刚才那根香蕉不是让你想起了童年吗？我给你弄点别的？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
Now that you mention it, there is one fruit that I really miss.
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
你这么一说，确实有一种水果让我很怀念。
小时候我最喜欢它了，但我记不清它叫什么名字了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
它是棕色的，外面有一层硬壳。里面有很多汁水，吃完果肉后还可以把壳当杯子用。
你知道那是什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
If you bring 5 of those things, I will reconsider your suggestion.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
如果你能给我带来5个那样的东西，我会重新考虑你的提议。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok so I have to bring 5 fruits with hard shells.
Hmm what is it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，所以我得带5个有硬壳的水果。
嗯，那是什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It was my favorite when I was young but I don't remember what it was called.
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
小时候我最喜欢它了，但我记不清它叫什么名字了。

scripts.text:
[Jasi]
It's brown and has a hard shell around it. It has juice inside and you can use it as a cup when you're done eating the fruit.
Do you know what it is?
scripts.translation:
[雅西]
它是棕色的，外面有一层硬壳。里面有很多汁水，吃完果肉后还可以把壳当杯子用。
你知道那是什么吗？

scripts.text:
- wait a second!! -
- you have too many items -
- so you can't get any more items. -
- make your body lighter -
- then try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你的物品栏太满了 -
- 所以无法再获得任何物品。 -
- 减轻你的负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text: - You take a beautiful water lily carefully in your hands. -
scripts.translation: - 你小心翼翼地接过一朵美丽的莲花。 -

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Wow it's really a great statue!
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
哇，这雕像真的很棒！

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
It is, isn't it?
This statue is called Verass Monument.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
是吧？
这座雕像叫做维拉斯纪念碑。

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
A long time ago there was a really brave adventurer named Verass, thanks to his dedicated exploration, Brasilis was able to develop into this great city.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
很久以前，有一位非常勇敢的冒险者名叫维拉斯。多亏了他不懈的探索，巴西才能发展成这样的大城市。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Awesome!!
i wanna become a real man like Verass.
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
太帅了！！
我想成为像维拉斯那样的真正的男子汉。

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Pedro, you can become whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
佩德罗，你想成为什么样子都可以。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Mariana is so smart, isn't she? hehe.
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
玛丽安娜真聪明，对吧？嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Ooooh! You love her don't you!
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
噢噢噢！你喜欢她，对不对！

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Wooooaaaa Pedro and Mari sitting in a tree!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
哇哦，佩德罗和玛丽坐在一棵树上！

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Woooo k-i-s-s-i-n-g~!!!
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
哇哦哦哦 亲~亲~亲~!!!

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Nya nya nya!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
喵~喵~喵~!

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Hahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Stop acting like babies!
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
别像小孩子一样闹了!

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Boys~!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
男孩们~!

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Yah yah...
Hey guys, did you hear that something happened a few days ago?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
是是是...
嘿，大家，你们听说前几天发生的事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Oh yeah~ I heard that something really scary happened.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
哦，是嘛~ 我听说发生了很可怕的事情。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Uh, yeah that's why Mariana got scared of going ot the bathroom for 3 days and everything was stinky. Ewwww~
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
嗯，对，所以玛丽安娜吓得三天不敢去厕所，结果到处都臭烘烘的。呕~

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Ha ha ha! Smelly Mari!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
哈哈哈！臭烘烘的玛丽！

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
I hate you~!
Stop spreading rumors about me. I'm not scared of the bathroom.
Pedro, do you think that I stink?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
讨厌你们~!
别再传我的谣言了。我才不怕厕所呢。
佩德罗，你觉得我臭吗？

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
Uh? Uh?
N......no... no way.
Hey guys~ be nice to her~
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
呃？呃？
不...不...不会吧。
大家~ 对她好一点~

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
kkkickkkkkkkkick
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
踢踢踢踢踢踢

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
kkkickkkkkkkk
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
踢踢踢踢踢踢

scripts.text: Walk by.
scripts.translation: 路过

scripts.text: Ask about the gossip.
scripts.translation: 打听八卦

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Mariana~ smells~ Nya nya~
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
玛丽安娜~ 好臭~ 喵~喵~

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Oh man you stink too~! Nya nya~
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
天哪，你也很臭~！喵~喵~

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Haven't you heard?
The ghost story in the art museum.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
你没听说吗？
美术馆里的幽灵故事。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Ooohhhh! Scary~~~!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
噢噢噢！好可怕~~~!

scripts.text: Can you tell me more?
scripts.translation: 能多告诉我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
A coupla days ago we went to the art museum for a picnic at school.
You know nothing special, just a ordinary field trip.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
前几天学校组织去博物馆野餐。
就是那种普普通通的校外活动啦。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Museums are boring so me and some friends snuck away from the group~!
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
博物馆太无聊了，所以我和几个朋友偷偷溜出去玩了~！

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
That's when we heard a scream echoing through the whole museum.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
就在这时，我们听到一声尖叫在整个博物馆里回荡。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
kkakkakkaaaah!!
kkieeeeeeh!
kehkeh..
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎啊！！
嘎啊啊啊啊啊！
嘎嘎嘎...

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
I heard the scream too...
You boys are always making noises where you're not supposed to.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
我也听到了那声尖叫...
你们这些男孩总是到处乱跑，发出奇怪的声音。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
What else are we supposed to do? If we don't do it someone else will.
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
不然我们要怎么做？如果我们不做，总会有别人去做的。

scripts.text:
[Mariana]
Argh~ Boys are so frustrating sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽安娜]
真是的~ 男孩有时候真让人头疼。

scripts.text: So then what happened?
scripts.translation: 后来发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Daniel and me guessed something weird was goin' on so we ran to where we thought the screams were comin' from.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
丹尼尔和我觉得有点不对劲，就跑去我们觉得声音传来的方向。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
They were coming from the bathroom.
Some kids got so scared that they started screaming too and closing their eyes. It got pretty bad.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
声音是从厕所传来的。
有些孩子吓得开始尖叫，还闭上了眼睛。场面挺混乱的。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
I think you pissed or pooped your pants. It smelled freakin' gross.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
我觉得你尿裤子或者拉裤子了。味道超级恶心。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Nah uh~ Your mom pissed her pants~ Nyah!
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
才没有~ 是你妈妈尿裤子了~ 哼！

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Nah uh~ You~ pissed your pants~
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
才没有~ 是你~ 尿裤子了~

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Anyway, so yeah, anyway that's how the rumor of the ghost in the museum started.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
总之，就这样，博物馆里有幽灵的传闻就是这么开始的。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Liar, there's no such thing as ghosts~
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
骗子，根本没有什么幽灵~

scripts.text: So was it a ghost?
scripts.translation: 那是幽灵吗？

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
How should I know?
No one could say they saw one and no one wanted to get in trouble from the teachers.
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
我怎么知道？
没人敢说自己看见了，也没人想被老师骂。

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
I heard if you say special magic words that the ghost will come out.
scripts.translation:
[佩德罗]
我听说如果你念出特定的咒语，幽灵就会出来。

scripts.text:
[Daniel]
Quit butting into our conversation Pedro.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼尔]
佩德罗，别插嘴。

scripts.text:
[Fabio]
Yah, what are you talking about, Pedro?
So did you see the ghost?
scripts.translation:
[法比奥]
是啊，你在说什么呢，佩德罗？
那你看到幽灵了吗？

scripts.text:
[Pedro]
N... no. I'm scared of ghosts.
But my friends said they saw one and they're not liars.

scripts.translation:
[幽灵]
就在那里，我在黑暗中摸索时
弄伤了一只眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I wandered these sewers for days until I found the end of this line connected to the toilet in the museum. I shouted forever begging for help but no one answered my calls.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵]
我在下水道里徘徊了好几天，
直到发现这条管道的尽头连接着博物馆的厕所。
我大声呼救，但没有人回应。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
You finally answered my call but it's already way too late. Thank you for at least checking. No one else has bothered to this day.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵]
你终于回应了我的呼唤，
但已经太迟了。
谢谢你至少来看看，
直到今天，还没有人这样做过。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
There are many dangerous creatures at the end of this sewer.
You seem brave though. I bet you wouldn't worry about the monsters there anyways.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵]
这条下水道的尽头有很多危险的生物。
不过你看起来很勇敢，
我想你大概不会担心那里的魔物吧。

scripts.text:
[Ghost]
I guess now I can finally rest in peace.
Thank you friend.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵]
我想我终于可以安息了。
谢谢你，朋友。

scripts.text: You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
scripts.translation:
你看到一根生锈的管道。
它似乎连接着丛林下方的某个地方。

scripts.text: Examine it
scripts.translation: 检查它

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 无视

scripts.text: You swim through a gap in the pipe and are swept by a sudden rush of water.
scripts.translation:
你游过管道上的缝隙，
被突然涌来的水流冲走了。

scripts.text: It might be dangerous, I better not act rashly.
scripts.translation:
这可能有危险，
我最好别鲁莽行事。

scripts.text: You see a rusty pipe. It seems to be linked to somewhere beneath the jungle.
scripts.translation:
你看到一根生锈的管道。
它似乎连接着丛林下方的某个地方。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
I'm still preparing.
I don't require your help at this time.
Please come back later...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
我还在准备中。
现在不需要你的帮助。
请稍后再来...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
To block Iara 
seducing the tribes
we need a purifying potion...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
为了阻止亚拉
诱惑部落，
我们需要一瓶净化药水...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Did you bring the materials
to make the purifying potion?
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你带来制作净化药水的材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Um... it seems to be okay.
I'll make you a potion which will
weaken Iara's power.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
嗯...看起来没问题。
我会为你制作一瓶能
削弱亚拉力量的药水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Let's see grind this...
and mix in that...
then add some magic...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
让我看看...研磨这个...
再混合那个...
然后加入一些魔力...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Here, it's completed.
Take this.
It will make Iara stop
training at the cave
for a while.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
好了，完成了。
请收下这个。
它会暂时让亚拉
停止在洞穴里修炼。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Please block the Iara threatening the security of the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
请阻止威胁部落安全的亚拉。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You haven't brought enough materials yet.
We cannot make the purification potion with only these.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你带来的材料还不够。
光靠这些我们无法制作净化药水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Ah... we need a strong adventurer.
The tribe is facing a major threat.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
啊...我们需要一位强大的冒险者。
部落正面临巨大的威胁。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
you are...
the adventurer who came for the
purification potion...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你是...
那位为了净化药水而来的冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Maybe because of the purification potion...
After that, the Iara stopped seducing tribesmen but the effect didn't last long.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
也许是因为那瓶净化药水...
之后亚拉停止了诱惑部落的男性，但效果并没有持续太久。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Could you get the same
materials as before...
I need your power.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你能再弄到和之前一样的材料吗...
我需要你的力量。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会去做的。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
This, ah...
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
这个，啊...
没有其他办法了。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You are truly brave!
I, on behalf of the tribe,
offer you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你真是勇敢！
我代表部落，
向你表示感谢。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Materials are the same as before.
If you just get^ff0000 20 Hearts of Mermaids,
10 Leopard Claws and
3 Ancient Lips^000000,
I will make you a potion that purifies evil spirits
by using a secret formula handed down to the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
材料和之前一样。
如果你能收集^ff0000 20个人鱼嘴巴、
10个花豹指甲和
3个人鱼嘴巴^000000，
我会利用部落传承的秘密配方，
为你制作一瓶能净化邪恶灵魂的药水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
The destiny of the tribe is up to you.
please get the materials quickly.
I will be preparing to make
the purification potion right here.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
部落的命运就掌握在你手中了。
请快点收集材料。
我会在这里准备制作净化药水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
There are some people I haven't seen before around here.
It's a good sign...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
最近这里出现了一些我没见过的人。
这是个好兆头...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Hey you...
Could you listen to my stories for a moment.
There's an emergency in our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
嘿，你...
能听我讲一会儿故事吗？
我们的部落出了急事。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You are a heartless person...
You don't seem the helpful type.
Just keep on going your way.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你真是无情...
你看起来不像个乐于助人的人。
那就继续赶路吧。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Thank you, I met a kind person.
It's a secret of our tribe that
you cannot tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
谢谢你，我遇到了一个善良的人。
这是我们部落的秘密，
你不能告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Lately young men from
the tribe are disappearing.
Our entire tribe is being threatened.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
最近部落的年轻男性
接连失踪。
整个部落都受到了威胁。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
It is likely because of a witch called Iara.
She is a water nymph seducing the hearts of young tribesmen at a cave behind the waterfall.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
这很可能是那个叫亚拉的巫女造成的。
她是一个水仙女，在瀑布后面的洞穴里诱惑部落年轻男性的心。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
How can I stop these young tribesmen?
But I discovered a way to make a purification potion to reverse the effects of the Iara's spells.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
我该如何阻止这些年轻的部落成员？
但我发现了一种制作净化药水的方法，可以逆转亚拉法术的效果。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
This potion has been handed down from many generations in our tribe.
This purification potion possesses the power to cleanse evil spirits.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
这瓶药水是我们部落世代相传的。
这瓶净化药水拥有驱除恶灵的力量。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
If you could get the materials
I will make you
the purification potion.
Could you do that for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
如果你能收集到材料，
我就能为你制作净化药水。
你能帮我做这件事吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes, I can.
scripts.translation: 是的，我可以。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Hm...
Well, then.
If you change your mind you can come to me again.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
嗯...
好吧。
如果你改变主意了，可以再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
You shouldn't talk about
what you heard now to anyone
It's kind of embarrassing...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
你刚才听到的事，
千万不要告诉任何人。
这有点尴尬...

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Oh! You are the savior
of our tribe indeed.
On behalf of the tribe, I offer you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
哦！你真是我们部落的救星。
我代表部落，向你表示感谢。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
Well, what we need is this.
It's all you can get from near here.
Note down well.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
嗯，我们需要这些材料。
这些都是附近能找到的。
请仔细记下来。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
^ff0000 20 Hearts of Mermaids
10 Leopard Claws
3 Ancient Lips^000000
are the only ones that are needed as the materials.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
^ff0000 20 人鱼心脏
10 花豹指甲
3 人鱼嘴巴^000000
只需要这些材料。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
When you get those, I will make you a potion that purifies evil spirits using a secret formula handed down to the tribe.
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
拿到这些材料后，我会用部落传承的秘密配方，为你制作一瓶能净化恶灵的药水。

scripts.text:
[Anori]
The destiny of the tribe is up to you.
I hope you move quickly.
Even at this moment, the village men are being seduced and slipping way...
scripts.translation:
[阿诺里]
部落的命运就掌握在你手中。
希望你能尽快行动。
此时此刻，村里的男人们正被诱惑，逐渐迷失...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I use a Purification Potion?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要使用净化药水吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Ah...this light is...
It's like getting cleansed of evil thoughts
from deep within my heart.
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
啊...这光芒是...
就像内心深处邪恶的念头被净化了一样。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
At last I can forget the curse that I placed on myself when I drowned in the water.
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
终于，我可以忘记自己溺水时施加在自己身上的诅咒了。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Do you think I can be born again as a kind water nymph?
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
你觉得我能重新转世为善良的水仙女吗？

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Ah... Thank you for helping me recover my consciousness for a while.
But... I think that the curse has been with me too long.
Get away from me quickly.
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
啊...谢谢你让我暂时恢复了意识。
但是...我觉得这个诅咒已经伴随我太久了。
快离开我。

scripts.text:
[Iara]
Ahhh~...
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
啊哈~...

scripts.text:
[Iara]
The curse is too strong for me to keep contained.
Leave now while you are safe.
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
诅咒的力量太强了，我快要控制不住了。
趁现在安全，快离开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I guess I should ignore her.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我想我应该无视她。）

[Iara]
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah.
Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeh.
Oooooooooooooooooh.
scripts.translation:
[亚拉]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊。
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯。
哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦。

[{0}]
Ugh! What's this strange voice?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啧！这是什么奇怪的声音？

scripts.translation:

啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊。
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯。
哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦哦。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啧！这是什么奇怪的声音？

scripts.text:
[Native Warrior]
Ah... the face I would never forget even in my dreams.
scripts.translation:
[原住民战士]
啊……那张脸，即便在梦中我也绝不会忘记。

scripts.text:
[Native Warrior]
When will she come out of the waterfall again...?
scripts.translation:
[原住民战士]
她什么时候才会再次从瀑布中现身……？

[{0}]
(Wh...what's this guy?)

[{0}]
(This guy will never

（这家伙永远都摆脱不了亚拉的诅咒……）
